// 03 / The operator

Project-management discipline, applied to GTM systems.

I'm Lyba, a Technical Project Manager transitioning into GTM Engineering. I have managed 15+ concurrent software projects, led client discovery, and kept developers, designers, and QA aligned around delivery.

Working closely with sales teams showed me where revenue processes break down. I saw repetitive research, scattered data, unclear CRM handoffs, and follow-ups that depended too heavily on manual work. That made me curious about building a better system.

I started exploring n8n and learned how triggers, APIs, and connected workflows can remove those gaps. From there, I moved into Clay, Apollo, CRM operations, and email sequencing. I realized this is the work I want to pursue seriously, so I am now building my career in GTM Engineering.

I learn by building and debugging real workflows. I'm also part of #WomenWhoClayPakistan and continue to sharpen my automation skills through hands-on projects.

WORKFLOW BUILDS

Real builds behind the source-to-sequence system.

These Clay tables show the execution layer behind my three routes: sourcing the right contact, cascading through data providers, verifying the result, and creating campaign-ready personalization.

WORKFLOW / 01 / SIGNAL-BASED SOURCING
HIRING-SIGNAL LEAD SCRAPER
GTM Lead Scraper: self-directed outbound pipeline

A company actively hiring for a GTM/RevOps role is a live buying signal, the same logic sales teams use to spot warm accounts. This pipeline scrapes live job postings for a target role, scores every result by fit, verifies who to actually contact, and drafts personalized outreach, built with Apify Actors for sourcing and custom Python for the scoring and verification logic that needed to be trustworthy.

7
Pipeline Stages
4
Real Bugs Found & Fixed
$0.58
Total Cost, First Full Run
The iteration story

Testing the enrichment Actor on 18 companies missing a contact returned 6 "contacts." Manual review found only 2 were real people. The tool had also flagged every guessed email as verified, including obvious fakes; its "verification" only checked that the domain had a working mail server, not that the person's inbox existed.

Scrape → Score (audit-able rubric) → Enrich missing contacts → Verify contacts + emails → Draft outreach

Wrote a deterministic filter that rejects fake contacts (job-board links, generic role labels, name-equals-company) and ran a second, independent email verifier, catching a 67% false-positive rate the enrichment tool's own "verified" label missed. Packaged as a reusable Claude Code skill and a public GitHub repo, with known limitations documented rather than glossed over.

WORKFLOW / 02 / SIGNAL-STACKED SOURCING
MULTI-SIGNAL SCORING + AI ARK ENRICHMENT
GTM Signal Stack: scored sourcing, not scraped lists

Most outbound lists start with a company name and a guess. This one starts with a live signal: companies actively hiring for GTM Engineer or RevOps roles, sourced straight from Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby job boards, not LinkedIn scraping. Every company gets scored for free using a formula that reads its own job description for stack mentions (Clay, Salesforce, HubSpot), before a single enrichment credit gets spent. Only the top scorers move to AI Ark for firmographics and growth signals, then into personalized first liners, subject lines, and full email bodies built from the real signal data, not a template.

The constraint that shaped the build

AI Ark's structured API needed Clay's paid HTTP column, not available on the free plan. Instead of upgrading, searched AI Ark's own UI directly for the shortlist, exported results, and merged them back into Clay by hand, a smaller, manual step that kept the whole pipeline on free tools without losing the data.

WORKFLOW / 03 / WATERFALL
WATERFALL ENRICHMENT
Caffinity: 6-layer email waterfall

Instead of stopping at "no email found," this table cascades every contact through six alternating find + verify layers, trying a new data provider each time the previous one misses, until a valid work email is confirmed or every option is exhausted.

LEAD ENRICHMENT + AI ICEBREAKERS
Marketing Manager lead list: enrichment + personalization

WORKFLOW / 05 / PERSONALIZATION
AI PERSONALIZATION PIPELINE
Rivi: fully personalized email, ready to send

The final stage of the pipeline: for every contact at Rivi, the table generates an AI company summary, segments the account (SMB), then writes a personalized first line, greeting, and full email body, tailored per person, not templated.

Campaign handoff: ready

Every contact now has a verified address and personalized email body. The enriched record can move out of Clay and into the activation layer:

Sync to CRM → HubSpot / Zoho → Launch via Instantly.ai / Smartlead → Warm up inboxes, 2–3 weeks Target: 2–3% bounce rate

New sending inboxes get warmed up gradually before the campaign goes live, so the domain builds sender reputation and stays well within a safe bounce rate, protecting deliverability for every email after it.
